text.p: Italian bonds futures edged slightly into negative territory watching the easier trend in German bunds and T-bonds while some profit taking persisted after a discount interest rate cut late Wednesday.

Futures followed an uncertain day unsure whether to push higher on the Italian rate cut news or watch the decline in other bond markets. The bearish view finally took hold and futures drifted off towards the close of the day.
"It was a rather uncertain day, but the rate cut was largely priced into the market so what we saw was bouts of profit taking throughout the day," said one LIFFE trader.

Italy's centre-left government received a welcome boost late Wednesday when it won a vote of confidence in parliament straight after the Bank of Italy reduced Italy's discount rate to 7.50 percent from 8.25 percent.
